business_summary: Baoding Tianwei Baobian Electric Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells power transmission and transformation equipment in China and internationally. The company offers shell-type, gas-insulated, phase-shifting, dry-type, and HVDC transformers, as well as variable shunt, smoothing, and fixed-capacity reactors. It also provides transformers for generation, transmission, distribution, railway, and industrial applications. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Baoding, China.
